sample_unit: consecutive head and neck cancer patients discussed at tumor board

links.outcome: Concordance of LLM treatment recommendations with current guidelines and tumor board decisions
links.effect: ChatGPT 3.5 and 4.0 suggested significantly more therapy options than the MDT; some recommended modalities, such as primary immunotherapy, are not part of current treatment guidelines.
links.quote: For clinical recommendation, explanation and summarization ChatGPT 3.5 and 4.0 scored well, but demonstrated to be mostly an assisting tool, suggesting significantly more therapy options than our MDT, while some of the recommended treatment modalities like primary immunotherapy are not part of the current treatment guidelines.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-3.5 and ChatGPT-4 against multidisciplinary tumor board recommendations for 20 head and neck cancer cases, focusing on model performance and accuracy without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
